native_evidence.facts: ANSI GetWindowTextA/CString<char> controls feed raw byte fields, DDV16-byte check; actual runtime ACP/IME unknown. No new native question or duplicate REA producer.

shared_api.environment: Pure ECMAScript strings/Map/typed arrays; no DOM,Node,TextEncoder,TextDecoder,filesystem,storage or network.
shared_api.profile_input: Explicit own data property encoding; no default ACP/locale/XML inference. ASCII is only the UI default.
shared_api.credential: Primitive scalar string up to64 UTF16 units, encoded1..16 bytes; rejects C0/DEL/C1 controls, NUL and unpaired surrogates. Preserves case/spaces/normalization exactly, no best-fit or replacement.
shared_api.profile_names: Actual owned Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer1..41B, strict decode + exact byte re-encode; no replacement/fallback. Caller data never mutated. Sorting remains original raw bytes outside the codec.
shared_api.windows936: Pinned Microsoft/Unicode table2.01/Unicode2.0,21791 unique double mappings,129 single mappings (ASCII plus80=Euro). Undefined pairs rejected; no GB18030 four-byte, PUA extensions or Windows best-fit claim.
shared_api.UTF8: Canonical1..4B scalar encoding, rejects overlong/continuation/surrogate/out-of-range sequences; BOM preserved as scalar, no NFC/NFKC.
shared_api.error_metadata: Controlled fixed messages/code and bounded byteLength/null only; never input text or provider errors.

UI.runtime_schema: moli.loopback.v3 advertises exact supported credentialEncodings, not actual target ACP. Native wire fields unchanged.
UI.default: Explicitly reset to ASCII on load/reload even under zh-CN and UTF8 XML; no profile persistence.
UI.selection: User explicitly selects account/name profile; switch clears username/password, consent, candidate session/result. Profile locked during review/config/text I/O/session; invalid/locked synthetic changes restore owned value.
UI.byte_counts: Live1..16B validation;8 Chinese chars in936=16B,9=18 rejected;5 Chinese UTF8 chars=15B,6=18 rejected;4 astral emoji=16B.
UI.ownership: Request captures the selected encoding before async session. Name rendering uses that capture; candidate handlers bind session owner and cannot select undecodable names or stale sessions.
UI.identity: The same exact encoded username bytes feed license MD5 identity and request10. XML decoding/cache encoding is independent; account profile/inputs not stored.
UI.name_display: Literal textContent; invalid/unknown encoding gets bounded byte-count placeholder with selection disabled, no automatic reinterpretation.
UI.example: node web/examples/launcher-browser-local.mjs --text-profile windows-936|utf-8; caller must explicitly choose matching UI profile; original public Chinese inputs only.
